Paulson Professor of Business Administration Read more Erik Stafford joined the faculty at HBS in July 1999, where he has taught finance in the required and elective curricula of the MBA Program and in the CFA Investment Management Workshop. Erik's research efforts focus on investment management, capital markets, and the financial system. Two of his papers have won annual prizes for research excellence.
